# show system global
FGT30D3X15012871 # config system global
    set alias "FGT30D3X15012871"
    set hostname "FGT30D3X15012871"
    set switch-controller enable
    set timezone 04
end

FGT30D3X15012871 #


# show system interface
FGT30D3X15012871 # config system interface
    edit "wan"
        set mode dhcp
        set allowaccess ping https ssh snmp http fgfm
        set type physical
        set role wan
        set snmp-index 1
    next
    edit "modem"
        set mode pppoe
        set type physical
        set snmp-index 2
    next
    edit "ssl.root"
        set type tunnel
        set alias "SSL VPN interface"
        set snmp-index 3
    next
    edit "lan"
        set ip 192.168.1.99 255.255.255.0
        set allowaccess ping https ssh http fgfm capwap
        set type hard-switch
        set stp enable
        set role lan
        set snmp-index 4
    next
end

FGT30D3X15012871 #


# get system interface physical
FGT30D3X15012871 # == [onboard]
	==[wan]
		mode: dhcp
		ip: 10.0.50.50 255.255.255.0
		ipv6: ::/0
		status: up
		speed: 1000Mbps (Duplex: full)
	==[modem]
		mode: pppoe
		ip: 0.0.0.0 0.0.0.0
		ipv6: ::/0
		status: down
		speed: n/a

FGT30D3X15012871 #


# show router static
FGT30D3X15012871 # config router static
    edit 1
        set gateway 10.0.50.1
        set device "wan"
    next
end

FGT30D3X15012871 #


# show router ospf
FGT30D3X15012871 # config router ospf
    config redistribute "connected"
    end
    config redistribute "static"
    end
    config redistribute "rip"
    end
    config redistribute "bgp"
    end
    config redistribute "isis"
    end
end

FGT30D3X15012871 #


# show router bgp
FGT30D3X15012871 # config router bgp
    config redistribute "connected"
    end
    config redistribute "rip"
    end
    config redistribute "ospf"
    end
    config redistribute "static"
    end
    config redistribute "isis"
    end
    config redistribute6 "connected"
    end
    config redistribute6 "rip"
    end
    config redistribute6 "ospf"
    end
    config redistribute6 "static"
    end
    config redistribute6 "isis"
    end
end
